summary: Michael Roumph, 53, of Pueblo West died in a private rafting accident at the Narrows Rapid in the Royal Gorge section of the Arkansas River ~5 mi west of Canon City ~5:30 p.m. Friday; the raft hit a river hydraulic ('hole') and threw him from the raft despite his personal flotation device and helmet; he was pulled from the river downstream, rescuers started CPR on-site and EMS transported him to the hospital where revival efforts failed; accidental drowning (Fremont County Coroner)
location: Narrows Rapid, Royal Gorge, Arkansas River (~5 mi west of Canon City)
responding_agency: Fremont County Sheriff's Office; EMS; Fremont County Coroner
notes: Pueblo Chieftain/Beacon Journal story dated 2020-06-08 ('Friday') parent-opened this run; incident date = the Friday before publication, 2020-06-05. Surfaced via the Pueblo-chunk search crawl (adjacent-scope Fremont County incident, not in DB). Zero Royal-Gorge-2020 rows before insertion.
